title: KITH_BIND_ADDR not in Config, no security note
description: KITH_BIND_ADDR is read inline in main.rs outside the Config layer, so it never appears in config.rs documentation. A reader of config.rs has no way to discover this variable exists. Additionally, the fallback path is a security downgrade (plain HTTP, no tailnet-only guarantee), not just a dev convenience — but the only signal is a tracing::warn. A comment should note that the fallback must never be used in production because it violates the tailnet-only binding guarantee.
